properties.areaDesc: Northwestern Interior Mendocino; Northeastern Interior Mendocino; Northern Lake
properties.headline: Frost Advisory issued November 2 at 12:00PM PST until November 3 at 9:00AM PST by NWS Eureka CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures as low as 33 will result in frost formation.

* WHERE...Northern Mendocino Interior, and Northern Lake.

* WHEN...From midnight tonight to 9 AM PST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Frost could harm sensitive outdoor vegetation. Sensitive
outdoor plants may be killed if left uncovered.
properties.instruction: Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.

NWSheadline: FROST ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM MIDNIGHT TONIGHT TO 9 AM PST TUESDAY

properties.areaDesc: Coastal Del Norte; Northern Coastal Humboldt; Southwestern Humboldt; Coastal Mendocino
properties.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued November 2 at 10:33AM PST until November 2 at 10:00PM PST by NWS Eureka CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Increased threat of sneaker waves expected.

* WHERE...Coastal Del Norte, Northern Coastal Humboldt,
Southwestern Humboldt and Coastal Mendocino Counties.

* WHEN...Until 10 PM PST this evening. .

* IMPACTS...Large, unexpected waves can sweep across the beach
without warning, sweeping people into the sea from rocks,
jetties, and beaches. These sneaker waves can also move large
objects such as logs, crushing anyone caught underneath.
properties.instruction:
Don't be fooled by an ocean that looks calm.  There can be
30 minutes of small waves before a sneaker wave strikes.  Avoid
rocks and jetties. Avoid steep beaches.  Stay much farther back
from the water and never turn your back on the ocean.

NWSheadline: BEACH HAZARDS STATEMENT REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 10 PM PST THIS EVENING

properties.areaDesc: Greater Lake Tahoe Area; Greater Lake Tahoe Area
properties.headline: Lake Wind Advisory issued November 2 at 10:04AM PST until November 3 at 4:00PM PST by NWS Reno NV
properties.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 15 to 20 mph with gusts up to 30 mph and
waves 1 to 3 feet, highest from mid-lake to eastern shores.

* WHERE...Greater Lake Tahoe Area.

* WHEN...From 9 AM to 4 PM PST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds and rough waves on area lakes will create
hazardous conditions for small craft.
properties.instruction:
Check lake conditions before heading out and be prepared for a sudden
increase in winds and wave heights. Consider postponing boating
activities on the lake until a day with less wind.

NWSheadline: LAKE WIND ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM 9 AM TO 4 PM PST TUESDAY

properties.areaDesc: San Francisco; Coastal North Bay Including Point Reyes National Seashore; San Francisco Peninsula Coast; Northern Monterey Bay; Southern Monterey Bay and Big Sur Coast
properties.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued November 2 at 5:08AM PST until November 3 at 8:00PM PST by NWS San Francisco CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...An increased risk for sneaker waves and strong rip
currents.

* WHERE...Pacific Coast beaches.

* WHEN...Through 8 PM Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Waves can sweep across the shoreline without
warning, pulling people into the sea from beaches, jetties,
and rocks.
properties.instruction:
Stay off of jetties, piers, rocks, and other waterside
infrastructure. Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous surf
and NEVER turn your back on the ocean. Monitor local weather,
surf and tide forecasts at www.weather.gov/mtr.

NWSheadline: BEACH HAZARDS STATEMENT REMAINS IN EFFECT THROUGH TUESDAY EVENING
